//_instructions: Copy this file, edit values, add assets/, and place in /opt/forge/themes/community/ or ~/.forge/themes/

meta.name: Neon Nights
meta.author: Your Name Here
meta.description: A vibrant neon theme for Forge OS with purple and cyan accents

colors.//_tip: Colors are hex RGB/RGBA. Use https://colorhunt.co or https://coolors.co for palette ideas.

fonts.//_tip: Fonts must be installed on the system. Inter and JetBrains Mono ship with Forge OS.

layout.//_tip: All values in pixels. Adjust sidebar_width for widescreen, padding for compactness.

animations.//_tip: Set enabled: false for zero-animation mode (faster on low-end hardware).

sounds.//_tip: Place .ogg/.wav files in assets/sounds/ and reference them here.
